_note: Defaults for the trial follow-up WhatsApp templates. Wording, timing, sending mode and test numbers are edited in admin → Settings → WhatsApp follow-ups (stored in site_settings 'whatsapp_followups'); this file is only used until something is saved there. Buttons, category and variables are fixed per stage because the code depends on them.

templates.label: Feedback ask
templates.body: Hi {{1}}, thank you for trying BroTin Box! How was your trial box on {{2}}? Tap a reply below or send us a message. We read every one and use it to make the food better.

templates.label: Plan offer
templates.body: Hi {{1}}, ready to keep the good food coming? On a BroTin Box Weekly plan each meal is {{2}}, and Monthly brings it down to {{3}}. Fresh, macro-counted meals 6 days a week, and you can skip or pause any day.

templates.body: Hi {{1}}, a last note from BroTin Box about your trial. Whenever you are ready, your meals can start from {{2}}, and the Monthly plan works out to {{3}} per meal. Have a question first? Just reply here and we will help.
